mapper.sql: id, code, name, description, built_in, enabled, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_role WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM sys_role WHERE code = #{code} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM sys_role WHERE code = #{code} AND enabled = 1 AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT r.id, r.code, r.name, r.description, r.built_in, r.enabled, r.create_time, r.update_time, r.create_by, r.update_by, r.deleted FROM sys_role r INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.deleted = 0 AND r.enabled = 1 AND r.deleted = 0 ORDER BY r.id

SELECT FROM sys_role WHERE deleted = 0
AND (code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND enabled = #{enabled}
ORDER BY built_in DESC, id ASC
